content.text: Working from the vehicle outside with a screwdriver, loosen the weatherstrip lip from the body.

content.description: Illustration showing weatherstrip being loosened from body using a screwdriver from outside of vehicle

content.text: From the outside, cut off the weatherstrip lip with a knife.

content.description: Illustration showing weatherstrip lip being cut off with a knife from outside, with circular detail view of cutting action

content.text: (c) Force the weatherstrip lip from the interior to the body flange outside. Pull the glass outwards and remove it with the weatherstrip.

content.description: Illustration showing weatherstrip lip being forced from interior to body flange, with circular detail view of hand pushing weatherstrip
